card.name: Linking words before New York places
card.fires_on: Small linking words (at, of, on, 's) and spacing right before an expected New York City place name, such as a Manhattan street, borough or institution. Also fires on digits within dates in New York history titles.

modes.label: Before NYC location
modes.description: A preposition or space that comes just before a New York street, borough or landmark.

modes.label: Inside New York context
modes.description: A word or number in a passage clearly about New York City, where the next words are likely NYC-specific.

card.writes: It promotes New York terms (NY, NYC, NYPD, Manhattan, Brooklyn) and Shanghai terms, and suppresses names of other Chinese provinces and places.
card.plain: It lights up when the text is heading toward a New York City place name.
